description: Owner decision 2026-10-15: now that the repo has a remote, every change lands through a GitHub PR. One branch and worktree per ticket; the agent pushes the branch and opens the PR (ticket id in the title), the owner reviews and merges with a merge commit; the ticket closes after the merge. Also: CI runs on push to main and on pull_request only, so a PR commit does not run the matrix twice (private repo, metered minutes).

title: Deliver code through pull requests, not direct merges to main
